page.overview:
Who is Ess Al?

Ess Al was a male Trandoshan imprisoned on Belsavis by the Galactic Republic. During the Invasion of Belsavis he and the other Trandoshans broke out and were recruited by the reconstituted Sith Empire to police and control other prisoners.
